Beat 4 Moon Flybys: two flybys within 80 miles, farthest 270,000 miles. Static graphics card with claim_ids ARTEMIS-07/08.

Closing credits card: sources, Kokoro narration, NOT_PUBLISHABLE notice. Static by design.
